studies.title: The telescope
studies.caption: Hans Lipperhey applies for a patent on a spyglass; Galileo turns one to the sky the next year.
studies.prompt: Close side view in a Dutch workshop around1608 of an early simple straight spyglass with leather-covered tube and two lens housings, hands fitting a small glass lens; leaded window and tools behind. No modern large astronomical mount or huge reflecting telescope.
